newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were flat from a lack of direction in early morning Monday trade after falling for five consecutive sessions last week, brokers said. They said that technically, a rebound was possible but elements to start it were few.
At 0011 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 was up 13.67 points or 0.07 percent at 20753.64. Its December futures were up 40 points at 20,810.
"There isn't really a market trend but the earnings season is starting and investors will buy shares of firms forecast to do well," a second-tier brokerage broker said.
